title: Presenting an Economic Case Study
grammar: Synthesis of proportional rates and economic crisis analysis
goal: I can deliver a comprehensive economic case study integrating proportional rates and quantitative changes

I can draw parallels between Márai Sándor's A gyertyák csonkig égnek and the dissolution of historical economic spaces
